rv.q: 3 stars-"The play is a solid contender, but it doesn't have quite enough surprising moves"

The thrill of the competition is elevated by Wilson Chin’s set design, Paul Whitaker’s mood-amplifying lighting, and Hana S. Kim’s projections that clue us in on everything from the competition score to the pyramid of ranks that fighters must climb to achieve GOAT-like yokozuna status.
